Package Client

Class GoNatureClient

java.lang.Object
OCSFUtils.AbstractClient
Client.GoNatureClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class GoNatureClient extends AbstractClient
The primary client communication class for the GoNature application. Extends the OCSF AbstractClient to handle network connections, sending requests to the server, and receiving server responses via the Strategy Pattern.
